question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 3 percent on simple interest and the interest received in 25 years is Rs. 600 less than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
solution:
**Given:**

Annual rate (R) = 3%

Time (T) = 25 years

Interest (I) = Sum lent (P) - 600

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100} 

Where, SI = Interest
